name: Flunitrazepam
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: Known as Rohypnol or 'roofies,' this infamous drug has similar qualities to most other benzodiazepines; sedating with strong hypnotic effects. Despite being known as a 'date rape drug,' it has only been implicated in a small number of such crimes. The drug has risks of CNS depression that is increased in combination with other depressants. The drug may cause amnesia and lowered inhibitions in overdose.
advisory: Potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids.

tolerance.buildUp: within a couple of days of continuous use
